verdict.rationale: Helicone explicitly documents Alerts for monitoring error rates and costs (helicone-docs-11), with alerts also listed as a paid-tier feature (helicone-docs-33), but there is no evidence of eval-score-drop alerting or of specific Slack/PagerDuty/email notification channel integrations — webhooks are documented but only as generic event notifications for automation, not as a named Slack/PagerDuty/email alerting integration. missing for 10: eval-score drop alerts, explicit Slack/PagerDuty/email delivery channels for alerts.
